name: Tropical Smoothie Tarantula | 1g
description:
Pineapple, mango, and a blend of tropical fruit. Sativa-forward, so the high is upbeat and creative. One of our most complex flavor profiles — the terpene blend changes as it burns. Good for sessions where you want to stay sharp.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
